preparation_policy: Independent coding/review may run in parallel; all source builds, tests and measurement processes run sequentially.

resources.storage: native WSL ext4 on E: NVMe

experiments.name: Reader-only source-scan avoidance
experiments.hypothesis: Initial whole-tree capture is avoidable on a command explicitly forbidden from publishing; retain admission and dependency validation.
experiments.comparison: Two fresh readers against two unmodified-reader observations from the same experimental binary/cache.
experiments.guard: All puts/publication forbidden in this mode. Full input pre/post state recorded externally. Not a writable fast path.

experiments.name: Bounded bulk loading of sealed packs
experiments.hypothesis: Bulk transfer removes enough per-record IO overhead to outweigh additional heap.
experiments.comparison: Two readers using E1 policy plus at most512MiB total sealed-pack snapshots, against E1.
experiments.guard: Keep index/header/key/checksum checks; no mmap; bound total reservation. Captured immutable bytes may outlive subsequent physical pack corruption, documented explicitly.

experiments.name: Compact batch input certificate
experiments.hypothesis: A flat deduplicated certificate for the same real dependency roots is cheaper than replaying serialized proof nodes.
experiments.comparison: Two warmups and three measured rounds per validation path; include certificate parse/check time and preparation cost; no full-build speed claim.
experiments.guard: Certificate binds exact root set,namespace,pinned pack/index; fresh content checks remain. Negative probes for content, directory membership and symlink changes. Test-only and never published.

experiments.name: Selective synchronous analysis frontier
experiments.hypothesis: Upstream frontier selection avoids serializing every eligible analysis node, reducing writer cost and pack size.
experiments.comparison: Fresh publisher plus two readers; same active directories, analysis-only selection and retained graph; compare writer to original publisher and reader to matching policy.
experiments.guard: Filter execution nodes before serialization; preserve checks. One repair maximum if integration fails, then report timebox/inconclusive.

acceptance: Output hashes and action-cache reuse must match; no correctness shortcuts promoted. Rank complete-command improvement, writer amortization, peak memory, and implementation feasibility. E3 is mechanism evidence only.
stopping: No automatic retries or extra measurements to chase favorable results. Per-process build timeout180s plus shutdown; stop earlier on corruption/resourceguard. Timebox expiry records incomplete rather than expanding scope.
